The '''Great Kinbury Basin''', also called the '''Kinbury Basin''' in source material, is a major geographic feature of [[Alberion]].

The source associates the basin with Alberion's lush rainforest environment and broader climatic importance. This draft does not define exact rivers, borders, cities, or protected areas.
